murder.oewn-02488014-v.label: negative

family.axis: killing softened into slang or euphemism → killing named outright as murder

murder.oewn-02488014-v.tone: The flat, full-weight name for the act, leaving the premeditation showing where *dispatch* and *remove* tidy it out of sight.

slay.oewn-02488014-v.label: negative

family.axis: killing softened into slang or euphemism → killing named outright as murder

slay.oewn-02488014-v.tone: Elevated and grave where *off* is curt, giving a planned killing a weight of ceremony rather than condemning it.

hit.oewn-02488014-v.label: negative

family.axis: killing softened into slang or euphemism → killing named outright as murder

hit.oewn-02488014-v.tone: Slang that treats a premeditated killing as a job done, the coolness of the word doing the work *murder* does with weight.

dispatch.oewn-02488014-v.label: negative

family.axis: killing softened into slang or euphemism → killing named outright as murder

dispatch.oewn-02488014-v.tone: Brisk and efficient, filing the killing under business concluded rather than under wrongdoing.

bump_off.oewn-02488014-v.label: negative

family.axis: killing softened into slang or euphemism → killing named outright as murder

bump_off.oewn-02488014-v.tone: Slang with a shrug in it, making the killing offhand and almost comic in a way *slay* never allows.

off.oewn-02488014-v.label: negative

family.axis: killing softened into slang or euphemism → killing named outright as murder

off.oewn-02488014-v.tone: One cold slang syllable, the deliberate act shrunk to a word too small to hold it.

polish_off.oewn-02488014-v.label: negative

family.axis: killing softened into slang or euphemism → killing named outright as murder

polish_off.oewn-02488014-v.tone: Informal and jaunty, its air of finishing a task neatly is exactly what makes it callous here.

remove.oewn-02488014-v.label: neutral

family.axis: killing softened into slang or euphemism → killing named outright as murder

remove.oewn-02488014-v.tone: The furthest euphemism in the set, rendering a premeditated killing as an act of tidying and hiding the intent inside the blandness.

burke.oewn-02488373-v.label: negative

family.axis: killing softened into slang or euphemism → killing named outright as murder

burke.oewn-02488373-v.tone: Names the killing by its method, leaving no mark on the body, and is chilling precisely because it is that specific where *murder* is general.

execute.oewn-02489797-v.label: negative

family.axis: killing softened into slang or euphemism → killing named outright as murder

execute.oewn-02489797-v.tone: Lends a planned murder the cold air of sentence carried out, borrowing an authority the act does not have.

trust.oewn-00690278-v.label: positive
trust.oewn-00690278-v.tone: The plain word of the family, giving confidence or faith directly, with none of the reckoning *calculate* brings or the staking *bet* brings.

credit.oewn-00685849-v.label: positive
credit.oewn-00685849-v.tone: Aims the trust at whether a thing is true rather than whether it will hold, granting belief where *lean* grants weight.

lean.oewn-00690162-v.label: neutral
lean.oewn-00690162-v.tone: Casts the reliance as bodily weight put on a support, carrying the hint that the one leaning could not stand unaided.

count.oewn-00714537-v.label: neutral
count.oewn-00714537-v.tone: Treats the confidence as already entered in the tally, so the thing believed in is settled rather than merely hoped for.

bet.oewn-00714537-v.label: neutral
bet.oewn-00714537-v.tone: Frames the faith as a stake laid down, conceding in the same breath that it could be lost, where *rely* concedes nothing of the kind.

depend.oewn-00714537-v.label: neutral
depend.oewn-00714537-v.tone: The confidence has need underneath it, with nothing else holding the one who depends upright.

swear.oewn-00714537-v.label: positive
swear.oewn-00714537-v.tone: Emphatic to the point of vouching, the faith declared aloud rather than quietly kept as in *rely*.

rely.oewn-00714537-v.label: neutral
rely.oewn-00714537-v.tone: Steady and unemphatic: confidence as a standing arrangement rather than the wager *bet* makes of it.

bank.oewn-00714537-v.label: neutral
bank.oewn-00714537-v.tone: Puts the faith down like a deposit, everything in one place and nothing held back.

look.oewn-00714537-v.label: neutral
look.oewn-00714537-v.tone: The faintest of the set, confidence as expectation turned toward a thing without the weight *lean* or *bank* place on it.

calculate.oewn-00714537-v.label: neutral
calculate.oewn-00714537-v.tone: Makes the confidence the outcome of working something out, so it sounds arrived at rather than felt.

reckon.oewn-00714537-v.label: neutral
reckon.oewn-00714537-v.tone: Informal, stating the faith as a settled count, plainer than *swear* and less deliberate than *calculate*.

depend_on.oewn-02670095-v.label: positive
depend_on.oewn-02670095-v.tone: Settled and unhedged - the trust is already placed and resting there, with none of the risk still audible in *bet* and none of the need implied by *lean*.

depend_upon.oewn-02670095-v.label: positive
depend_upon.oewn-02670095-v.tone: The weightier, more formal cast of *depend on*, claiming exactly the same confident placing of trust.

rely_on.oewn-02670095-v.label: positive
rely_on.oewn-02670095-v.tone: Trust placed with assurance, active and chosen where *depend on* keeps the note of need.

rely_upon.oewn-02670095-v.label: positive
rely_upon.oewn-02670095-v.tone: Formal beside *rely on*, the same confident placing of trust carried with a stiffer bearing.

respect.oewn-00695834-v.label: positive
respect.oewn-00695834-v.tone: The plainest way of holding something high, without the warmth of *admire* or the hush of *revere*.

esteem.oewn-00695834-v.label: positive
esteem.oewn-00695834-v.tone: Formal and cool: high regard delivered as an assessment rather than a felt rush.

value.oewn-00695834-v.label: positive
value.oewn-00695834-v.tone: Casts the high regard as worth — what the thing is worth to the holder, not what it stirs in them.

prize.oewn-00695834-v.label: positive
prize.oewn-00695834-v.tone: The regard of someone who would not part with it; more possessive than *value*.

prise.oewn-00695834-v.label: positive
prise.oewn-00695834-v.tone: Carries the treasuring force of *prize* exactly, under a different spelling.

think_the_world_of.oewn-00696274-v.label: positive
think_the_world_of.oewn-00696274-v.tone: Idiomatic and whole-hearted, an open overstatement where *esteem* keeps its measure.

reverence.oewn-01782485-v.label: positive
reverence.oewn-01782485-v.tone: Lifts the object past approval into the hallowed, met with awe rather than judged.

fear.oewn-01782485-v.label: positive
fear.oewn-01782485-v.tone: The member in which awe keeps its edge of dread — respect owed to something too exalted to face lightly.

revere.oewn-01782485-v.label: positive
revere.oewn-01782485-v.tone: The felt act of reverence, awe aimed at what is held sacred, far past *respect*.

venerate.oewn-01782485-v.label: positive
venerate.oewn-01782485-v.tone: Treats the object as hallowed, the regard almost ceremonial where *admire* is simply warm.

admire.oewn-01831800-v.label: positive
admire.oewn-01831800-v.tone: A felt response to something, where *esteem* is a verdict on it.

look_up_to.oewn-01831800-v.label: positive
look_up_to.oewn-01831800-v.tone: Admiration that puts the object above the one feeling it; plainer and more informal than *venerate*.

grieve.oewn-01801358-v.label: neutral

family.axis: sadness felt on one's own account → suffering deliberately taken on with another

grieve.oewn-01801358-v.tone: The plain full-weight word for grief felt as grief, neither approving nor blaming the one who feels it.

sorrow.oewn-01801358-v.label: neutral

family.axis: sadness felt on one's own account → suffering deliberately taken on with another

sorrow.oewn-01801358-v.tone: Makes the grief sound inward and sustained where *grieve* sounds like something done.

mourn.oewn-01801062-v.label: neutral

family.axis: sadness felt on one's own account → suffering deliberately taken on with another

mourn.oewn-01801062-v.tone: On this sense it asks only for sadness, short of the weight *grieve* insists on.

feel_for.oewn-01825946-v.label: positive

family.axis: sadness felt on one's own account → suffering deliberately taken on with another

feel_for.oewn-01825946-v.tone: Warm and plain-spoken, the sharing conveyed with none of the formality of *condole with*.

pity.oewn-01825946-v.label: neutral

family.axis: sadness felt on one's own account → suffering deliberately taken on with another

pity.oewn-01825946-v.tone: Shares the suffering from slightly above it, so the warmth carries a downward tilt that *sympathize with* has not.

compassionate.oewn-01825946-v.label: positive

family.axis: sadness felt on one's own account → suffering deliberately taken on with another

compassionate.oewn-01825946-v.tone: The most morally weighted here - sharing the suffering treated as a virtue exercised, and stiff enough as a verb to sound elevated.

condole_with.oewn-01825946-v.label: positive

family.axis: sadness felt on one's own account → suffering deliberately taken on with another

condole_with.oewn-01825946-v.tone: Formal and ceremonious - the sharing is performed toward the sufferer rather than merely felt.

sympathize_with.oewn-01825946-v.label: positive

family.axis: sadness felt on one's own account → suffering deliberately taken on with another

sympathize_with.oewn-01825946-v.tone: The mildest of the sharing words, acknowledging and joining the suffering at conversational temperature.
